title_sq: Shitet apartament 2+1 me nje pamje fantastike tek Kopshti Botanik!
description_sq:
Apartamenti ndodhet tek Xhamija , Kopshti Botanik!
Me nje pamje panoramike te liqenit dhe qyteit apartamenti zoteron siperfaqe totale prej 170 m2 nga te cilat 60 m2 jane verande.
Organizohet ne :
- Salloni bashke me kendin e gatimit.
- 2 dhoma gjumi
- 1 tualet me dritare
- Verande ma pamje unike te kodrave te liqenit dhe Tiranes
- Mundesi blerje parkimi me cmim extra,
- kati i 2-te pa ashensor
Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale with a fantastic view at the Botanical Garden!
description_en: The apartment is located at the Mosque, Botanical Garden! With a panoramic view of the lake and the city, the apartment has a total area of ​​170 m2, of which 60 m2 are verandas. It is organized in: - Living room with cooking corner. - 2 bedrooms - 1 bathroom with window - Veranda with a unique view of the hills of the lake and Tirana - Possibility to purchase parking at an extra price, - 2nd floor without elevator The property has regular mortgage documentation
